description: This file contains the implementation of the 'Voucher' class within the Opencart catalog extension for total calculations. It includes methods for handling voucher totals, confirming and unconfirming vouchers related to orders, and interacting with voucher data stored in the session and database.

classes.name: Voucher
classes.description: Represents a voucher total extension in the OpenCart system, capable of calculating voucher discounts and managing voucher confirmation states.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Calculates and applies voucher totals to the order, adjusting the total price and recording voucher usage.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Confirms a voucher based on order information, recording voucher usage and associating it with the order.

methods.name: unconfirm
methods.description: Unconfirms or reverses the voucher application associated with a given order.
